android.desc:
GoPico | Play PICO-8 Games on Android

GoPico is a lightweight Android app for discovering and playing curated PICO-8 games with fast startup, low input latency and a clean, ad-free experience.

GoPico is a game distribution and playback platform.

---

HOW GOPICO WORKS

• GoPico does not include or distribute the PICO-8 editor or native executable
• Games are played inside a web-based PICO-8 player embedded in the app
• The app hosts only .p8.png cart files that are
     - Released under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, or
     - Explicitly approved by the game’s author for redistribution
• There is no access to the full Lexaloffle library
• Users cannot import private carts
• There is no monetization

All content in GoPico is either freely redistributable by license or shared with direct permission from the creator.

---

FEATURES

• Curated collection of high-quality PICO-8 games
• Search and discovery to browse games easily
• Instant tap to play
• Optimized for low input latency and fast startup
• Touch-friendly controls
• No ads
• No invasive permissions

---

ABOUT PICO-8

PICO-8 is a fantasy console created by Lexaloffle.
GoPico is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Lexaloffle.

If you enjoy creating games with PICO-8, please consider supporting the official project by purchasing the editor from:
[https://www.lexaloffle.com](https://www.lexaloffle.com)

---

IMPORTANT NOTES

• GoPico is intended for playing freely distributed and author-approved games only
• It does not provide the PICO-8 editor or development tools
• It does not provide access to private or paid carts

Built for the PICO-8 community, with respect for creators and for the original platform.

Happy gaming.

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I’ve released GoPico v1.0, a native Android app for running PICO-8 carts locally, with a focus on minimizing startup time, input latency, and rendering overhead compared to browser-based players.

The app executes carts on-device and is optimized specifically for mobile hardware.

Current scope:

~350 curated carts used for compatibility and performance validation

No ads, no accounts, no monetization

First public release

Planned next steps:

Physical controller support

Tuning for handheld devices

Broader compatibility and performance testing

If you try it, feedback is especially useful if it includes:

Device model and Android version

Any crashes, inaccuracies, or performance regressions

Game List:
https://paste.rs/vVrKl.md

Community Discord(for bug reports):
https://discord.gg/vRzyKKS9VY
